<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/expansions"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the terms that a search for `q` should also match, based on the
entries in a synonym set. Call this endpoint at query time, then send all
returned terms to your search engine.

The API compares `q` to terms and synonyms as whole values, regardless of
case. Each matching entry adds terms according to its relationship type:

- `EQUIVALENT`: if `q` is the `term` or one of the synonyms, the response
  includes the `term` and all synonyms.
- `ONE_WAY`: if `q` is the `term`, the response includes all synonyms. If `q`
  is only a synonym, the entry adds nothing.
- `GROUP`: if `q` is one of the synonyms, the response includes all synonyms.
  The `term` never matches.

If several entries match, the response combines their terms without
duplicates. Expansion doesn't chain: terms that one entry adds don't match
other entries. If no entry matches, `terms` contains only `q`.
